title: Art Card: Jacob's Ladder, 1957 (Hand Signed by Helen Frankenthaler)
medium: Offset lithograph postcard (hand signed and dated by Helen Frankenthaler)

said.q: concern with line, fluid line, calligraphy, and… experiments with line not as line but as shape.

Details about that piece: Jacob’s Ladder , 1957 Oil on canvas Although it shares a name with the biblical tale of Jacob’s dreamed ascent toward heaven, and also with an ancient Egyptian toy, Frankenthaler insisted this work had no illustrational intention: “The Picture developed (bit by bit while I was working on it) into shapes symbolic of an exuberant figure and ladder, therefore Jacob’s Ladder.”

events.q: Collection of Dan Pope, ex-CBS cameraman who amassed one of the best collections of visual artist autographs during the 1980s and 1990s
